items.name: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.desc: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

items.name: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
items.desc: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

items.name: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
items.desc: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

items.name: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability

items.name: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
items.desc: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

items.name: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
items.desc: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

items.name: UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability
items.desc: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

items.name: Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
items.desc: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

items.name: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
items.desc: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

items.name: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
items.desc: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

items.name: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
items.desc: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

items.name: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
items.desc: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.
